REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MARCH 28, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made during regular business hours by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 6.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE SUCCESSOR
AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY, MARCH 28, 2024,
7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

 2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

 3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Olivia Mendoza, Girl Scout Gold Award recipient.

 4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Chuong Vo
  Council/Agency Member Frank Aurelio Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair Bruce W. Barrows

 5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Pursuant to City Council consensus, the presentation of Item 5B was considered prior to
  Item 5A during the meeting.

 5A.  Presentations

  A proclamation was made by the City Council honoring:

  Macaroni Grill (Business Spotlight).

  Olivia Mendoza (Girl Scout Gold Award recipient).

  as the Executive Director of the Gateway Cities Council of Governments (COUNCIL).

  Mayor Bruce W. Barrows introduced Hector De La Torre, Executive Director of the Gateway
  Cities Council of Governments. An informational report was given.

 5C.  Review and consideration of appointments, removals, and filling of scheduled or unscheduled
  vacancies on the Cerritos Advisory Boards (2022-24 term) (COUNCIL).

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Seeing none, the Mayor declared the
  public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Barrows, to approve Councilmember
  Johnson’s nomination, as listed below, to fill an unscheduled vacancy of an unexpired two-
  year term of service expiring April 30, 2024 (COUNCIL):

  Nominee Name  Advisory Board
  Rosa Peters  Let Freedom Ring Committee

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of provisions of the Art in Public Places Program relating to
  developer contribution thresholds and the definition of “public” as it relates to the location
  of art within the community (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Sam Desai commented on various aspects related to maintenance of the subject art pieces.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Solanki, to direct the City Manager and
  City Attorney to prepare and schedule an agenda report on a future Planning Commission
  meeting agenda and return recommendations to the City Council, regarding a
  Development Code Amendment ordinance, amending Chapter 22.94 of the Cerritos
  Municipal Code by:

  1. Clarifying the definition of “public place” to include any interior area on public property
  which is regularly open during business hours and easily accessible to the public; and

  2. Modifying the $450,000 maximum developer contribution amount adjusted by the
  Consumer Price Index (CPI) from the date of enacting the Art in Public Places program
  and allowing for annual adjustments, based on the CPI (COUNCIL).
